# generated by scripts/sync-docs.mjs
title: "Watching it"
description: "Health, readiness, Prometheus metrics and traces for every run and step, so a stuck job shows up on a graph and not in a complaint."
editUrl: false
---

`/healthz` says the process is up. `/readyz` says it can do its work: the
database answers and has the schema this binary needs. `/metrics` is Prometheus:
executions by status and how long they took, the time spent in each step type,
how many executions are queued, running or waiting and how long the oldest has
waited, webhook latency, OAuth refresh failures and which triggers hold a
connection. They share the main address, or have an address of their own with
`HOTLOOP_CASCADE_OPS_LISTEN` (a worker has no other address, and uses `:8081`).
`HOTLOOP_CASCADE_METRICS_TOKEN` makes `/metrics` want a bearer token.

Every execution is one OpenTelemetry trace with a span for each step. Name an
OTLP endpoint with the standard variables (`OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` and its
family) and spans are sent there; with none named nothing is sent. The trace id
is the execution's id, or the trace of the caller when a webhook arrives with a
`traceparent`, and the HTTP step sends one on to what it calls.
